༄༅/ /byang chub chen por sems bskyed pa'i cho ga shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// byang chub chen por sems bskyed pa'i cho ga shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bcom ldan 'das kyi rgyal tshab rje btsun byams pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i khams kun byang chub cher// bsgyur ba'i sems bskyed gser 'gyur rtsi// gang la mnga' ba de kun la// 'phags nor 'dod pas bdag 'dud do// 'dir jo bo rje lha gcig gam slob dpon chen po mar me mdzad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas kyis ji ltar gsungs pa'i theg pa chen por sems bskyed pa'i cho ga bya bar 'dod pas/ slob dpon gyi spyan sngar 'dug ste gsol ba gdab par bya'o// ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sa chen po la zhugs pa rnams kyis dang por bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang slob dpon gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis so// de nas slob dpon gyis de skyabs su 'gror gzhug ste/ dkon mchog la dmigs pa'i phyag gsum btsal nas/ mdun du tsog pu lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar bas 'dug tu bcug nas/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas gzung nas ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// chos rnams kyi mchog zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum gyis so// de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la dmigs te bzang spyod nas byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa byas nas/ slob dpon gyi spyan sngar pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs pas sam sngar bzhin gyis 'dug nas smon pa byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya ste/

slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan dang*/ gzhan dag tu sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang*/ sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas gzung nas byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen po la sems bskyed par bgyi'o// sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o// dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o// yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar bgyi'o// de nas slob dpon gyis khyod kyis smon pa byang chub tu sems bskyed cing*/ byang chub kyi sgor zhugs pa yin pas/ byang chub kyi sems nyams par byed pa/ bla ma dang mchod par 'os pa bslu ba dang*/ gzhan 'gyod pa'i gnas ma yin pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa dang*/ sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la zhe sdang gis tshigs su bcad pa ma yin pa brjod pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la g.yo dang sgyus spyod pa bzhi las zlog par bya'o// byang chub kyi sems nyams par byed pa'i chos/ srog gi phyir yang bsams bzhin du brdzun mi smra ba dang*/ sems can thams cad la lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas gnas par bya yi g.yo sgyus ma yin pa dang*/ sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed cing phyogs bcur yang dag pa'i yon tan brjod par bya ba dang*/

sems can 'ga' zhig dge ba la 'god pa de dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'god kyi/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la ni ma yin pa ste bzhi la bslab par bya'o// gzhan yang chos bcu pa zhes pa'i mdo las gsungs pa dag la'ang bslab par bya ba yin no// de ltar smon pa'i sems bskyed pa 'di'i phan yon ni/ sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las dpag tu med pa gsungs shing*/ byang sa las/ byang chub sems dpa' ni sems bskyed ma thag tu bla na med pa'i byang chub theg pa chen po la zhugs pa yin te/ zhes nas/ de ltar dang po sems bskyed pa de ni bsdu ba dang*/ rtsa ba dang*/ rgyu mthun pa dang*/ rten du gyur pa las rig par bya'o// zhes gsungs so// 'jug pa'i sems bskyed pa la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rkang par gtugs la phyag byas te 'dug la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen kyang byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la gnas pa/ de'i sdom pa'i cho ga shes pa/ de 'bogs pa'i sgo nas slob ma rjes su 'dzin nus pa zhig dgos pa de bdag gis 'grub rung du yod do byas te/ 'di skad brjod du bcug slob dpon khyed las bdag byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang ba de len par 'tshal gyi/ de la gnod pa ma mchis na bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du cung zad cig gsan cing stsal bar rigs so// lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo// slob dpon gyis/ khyod 'di ltar sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*/ dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi gdung rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod dam/ des 'dod do// de la khyod kyi sems bskyed pa brtags pa dang*/ yi dam brtan par bya'o// gzhan dang 'gran pa'i ched du ma yin nam/ ma yin no// gzhan gyi nan gyis len du bcug pa ma yin nam/

ma yin no// zhes lan gdab/ smon pa blangs pa'i de ma thag tu len na bdun rnam dag sngar gyi de kas thus la/ min na 'dir de bya'o// de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ston pa'i 'du shes gyis la phyag gsum tshol cig byas te sngar bzhin 'dug pa la/ slob mas 'di ltar bskul bar bya ste/ slob dpon gyis byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang ba bdag la myur du stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis so// bla mas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod byang chub sems dpa' yin nam/ yin lags/ byang chub tu smon lam btab bam/ btab lags/ zhes khas blang*/ de nas/ mi zad pa dpag tu med pa'i bsod nams kyi gter chen por gyur pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ring por mi thogs par thob par 'gyur ro snyam bsams sems rab tu dang bar 'gyur bas dga' ba dang rangs pa bcas te cang mi smra bar 'dug la/ slob dpon gyis/ byang chub sems dpas mi slob pa'i// dngos de gang na'ang yod min la// zhes gsungs pas/ des bslab par bya ba'i gnas mtha' dag sus brjod par nus/ 'on kyang a ti shas/ 'jug pa'i sems kyi bdag gnyid sdom gnas pas// tshul khrims bslab pa gsum la legs bslabs pas// zhes gsungs pa/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba chos sdud pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ sems can don byed pa'i tshul khrims gsum du 'du ba yin la/ dang po ni/ so so thar pa las ji skad gsungs pa bzhin bcas pa rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba rnams dgag pa'i gnyen po'i chu lon brtsigs pa yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gam bcu la sogs pa legs par bsgrub cing nan tan du sbyong ba/ gsum pa ni/ rang gi nus pa'i yul/ sems can la 'di dang phyi ma thams cad du bde ba 'byung ba zhig 'dug na de'i grogs byed dgos pa yin no gzhan du na/ bde yang mi phan mi bya'o// zhes pas/

gnas skabs su bde yang phugs de mi phan pa'i rgyur 'gro ba dang*/ phugs gnod par 'gyur ba rtsom pa thams cad la zlog pa'i grogs bya dgos pa yin no// de bas na byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims ni de dag yin la/ de bdag las len par 'dod dam/ zhes dri/ des len par 'tshal lo// zhes lan btab/ de ltar khas len par gyur na/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa byin pa ni/ btsun pa'am/ tshe dang ldan pa'am/ rigs kyi bu ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba las 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ tshul khrims su gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ tshul khrims su gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na da lta byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ tshul khrims su gyur pa gang yin pa/ bslab pa'i gzhi dag dang*/ tshul khrims gang dag la 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bslabs par gyur pa dang*/ ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis slob par 'gyur ba dang*/ phyogs bcu dag na da lta byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad da lta slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad de sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba chos sdud pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ sems can don byed pa'i tshul khrims nod dam des nod do// de ltar lan gnyis lan gsum brjod pas sdom pa de blangs par 'gyur pa yin no// de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal te/ thal mo sbyar bas 'dug la/ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya bas/

bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba las/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang bar bya ba lan gsum gyi bar du yang dag par mnos lags te/ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba 'dis byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa la/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dpang du gyur par 'phags pa'i chos lkog tu gyur kyang*/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mthas gtugs pa'i chos thams cad lkog tu ma gyur ba'i thugs mnga' ba thams cad la mkhyen par gsol lo// zhes lan gsum brjod/ 'di ni slob dpon gyis so// de nas slob mas phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon gnyis ka langs te/ slob dpon gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod nyon cig 'di ni chos nyid yin te/ gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa'/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yang dag par len pa'i las brjod pa rdzogs pa de'i tshe/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'di lta bu'i ltas 'byung bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing ga ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya bas/ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba las byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yang dag par blang ba mnos so// zhes yang dag par mkhyen par 'gyur ro// de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyi chos kyi brtse bas bu dang spun zla'i dgongs pa mdzad la/ de ltar dgongs pa mdzad pas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs 'phel bar 'gyur ro// zhes brjod pa gzigs 'jug go /yang slob dpon gyis byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod nyon cig byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yang dag par blang ba 'di dad pa med pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/

gang gi phyir dad pa med pa rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa rab tu bstan na/ dad pa med pa'i sems can de dag byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la ma dad pas spong bar byed de/ des na ji srid byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la gnas pa la bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par 'gyur ba/ de snyed kyi bsod nams ma yin pa'i phung po ma dad pa de la ldan par 'gyur ro// gang gi phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems can sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su bsrung bar bya ba yin pas/ gzhan sdig pa las bzlog par bya ste/ de'i phyir mchog tu dge ba'i byang chub sems dpas gsang bar bya ba yin no// 'di ni gya tshoms su smra ba dgag pa yin no// de nas bslab pa brjod de// byang chub tu sems bskyed pa 'di thob pa'i byang chub sems dpas rnyed pa dang bkur sti la lhag par zhen te bdag bstod pa dang*/ gzhan la smad na ni byang chub sems dpa' pham pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos dang po'o// longs spyod dag yod de/ bdag bzhin du chags pa'i rang bzhin gyis sdug bsngal ba dang*/ bkren pa dang*/ mgon med pa dang*/ rten med pa'i slong ba po legs par 'ongs pa rnams la snying sra bas zang zing mi gtong ba dang*/ chos la ser sna byed pa'i phyir don du gnyer ba 'ongs pa rnams la chos kyi bgo bsha' mi byed pa pham pa'i gnas lta bu gnyis pa'o// tshig rtsub por smras pa tsam gyis gtong bar mi byed de/ khro ba'i kun nas dkris pa de lta bu 'phel bar byed la/ khro bas zil gyis non pas lag pa'am/ bong ba'am/ dbyug pas sems can rnams la brdeg par byed rnam par 'tshe bar byed/ rnam par mtho 'tsham par byed pa dang*/ khro ba'i bsam pa bdo ba kho na zhe la gzung ste/ gzhan dag gis bshad kyis sbyangs kyang mi nyan zhing mi bzod la bsam pa mi gtong ba 'di yang pham pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos gsum pa'o// byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod la skur pa 'debs pa dang*/

bdag nyid dam gzhan dag gis g.yom la dam pa'i chos ltar bcos pa la mos nas/ dam pa'i chos ltar bcos pa rnams la dga' ba dang*/ rtog pa dang*/ 'jog pa ni pham pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos bzhi pa'o// pham pa'i gnas lta bu bzhi po 'di dag las gang yang rung ba zhig kun nas dkris pa chen pos spyad na byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa gtong bar 'gyur pas khyed kyis ngo tsha shes pa dang*/ bag yod pa dang*/ khrel yod pas gnas 'di dag spang bar bya'o// gzhan nyes byas kyi ltung ba nyon mongs pa can dang*/ nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa rnams kyang bsgrims te bsrungs pas ma gos par bya'o zhes pas so// bla ma med na rang gis len pa'i tshe dgongs gsol la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dgongs su gsol zhes pa tsam mo// de yang zla 'od gzhon nu'i zhal snga nas kho bo'i yongs su 'dzin pa dpal 'brug pa rin po che'i bar gyi bla ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes gsung gi gsang ba ma bslad pa'o/// / byang chub sems dpa'i sa las gsungs pa/ sems bskyed pa rnam pa gnyis bsdus par blang ba ni/ kye ma bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig sems can thams cad kyi don yang byed cing shin tu mthar thug pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes la 'god par gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod pa smon pa'o// rten nam yid kyis rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa'i spyan sngar bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te 'dug pa'am/ tsog pur 'dug thal mo sbyar bas/ 'di skad du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la gsol ba 'tshal te/ de dag gi spyan sngar byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad/

sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba'i chos sdud pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ sems can don bya ba'i tshul khrims gang la/ 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bslabs pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad slob par 'gyur ba dang*/ phyogs bcu na da lta byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad da ltar slob pa rnams bdag gis yang dag par blang ngo zhes lan gnyis lan gsum brjod pas so/// / srid pa'i phan bde'i yal 'dab kun gyi gzhi// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa bon drung po ba// gang zhig sems kyi dam pa'i padma ni// skyes pa'i yid rdzing thams cad phyag bya'i gnas// 'dir dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed len pa'i cho ga byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug las ji ltar gsungs pa bri bar bya ste/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes so// dang po ni/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/ sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa che mthong nas// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyis// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// zhes skyabs 'gro/ de nas phyag dang dngos su 'byor pa'i mchod pa bstar te/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun// bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la// lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o// bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis// rgyal ba thams cad yid kyis mngon sum du// zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis// rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag /de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa// thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos// de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams// dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis// rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// me tog dam pa 'phreng ba dam pa dang*// sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang*// mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang*// phye ma'i phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang*// bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba// de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos// bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni// lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang*// sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras// rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang*// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang*// gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma dag

/byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes// mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la// 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul// mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la// 'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir// bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang*// bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi// phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// zhes yan lag bdun pa bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems ni rnam pa gnyis te/ smon pa dang 'jug pa ste/ byang chub sems de mdor bsdu na// byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni// byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no// zhes pas so// de gnyis kyang*/ lam du 'gro 'dod pa dang 'gro bzhin pa'i khyad lta bur gsungs te/ 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi// bye brag ji ltar shes par bya// de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi// bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya// zhes so// de bas na de gnyis kyi phan yon la yang*/ byang chub smon pa'i sems las ni// 'khor tshe 'bras bu che 'byung yang*// ji ltar 'jug pa'i sems bzhin du// bsod nams rgyun chags 'byung ba min// gang nas gzung ste sems can khams// mtha' yas rab tu sgrol ba'i phyir// mi ldog pa yi sems kyis su// sems de yang dag blangs gyur na// de nas gzung ste gnyid log gam// bag med gyur kyang bsod nams shugs// rgyun mi 'chad pa du ma zhig /nam mkha' mnyam pa rab tu 'byung*// zhes gsungs pa bla na med pa'i byang chub tu smon pa tsam yang phan yon dpag tu med na/ byang chub tu zhugs nas spyad pa spyod pa lta ci smos snyam sems la gzhog cig /ces skabs dang bstun pa'i bshad pa bya/ rang nyid kyis len pa la bshad pa 'di dag mi dgos/ sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis byang chub tu thugs bskyed de bslab pa la ji ltar bslabs pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su bzhag pa'i phyir byang chub tu sems bskyed cing byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la rim pa bzhin slob par bya'o snyam pas/

ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar// de bzhin 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab pa rnams// rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi// zhes lan gsum/ rjes ni/ bdag gi sems gzengs bstod pa'i phyir/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te// skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la// rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya// gzhan dag dga' ba bskyed pa'i phyir du ni/ bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi// spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni// bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyi// lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis// zhes lan gcig brjod par bya'o// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nod nas rtsa ba'i ltung ba rgyal po la 'byung nye ba lnga/ blon po la 'byung nye ba lnga/ phal pa la 'byung nye ba brgyad de bco brgyad/ rdzas kyi sgo nas blon po'i rnams gcig tu 'dus pas bcu bzhi/ byang sa nas bshad pa'i pham bzhi dang nyan rang du sems bskyed rnams bsrung*/ gang las ltung ba dang ltung ba'i gzugs brnyan/ gang las ltung med dang ltung med kyi gzugs brnyan du 'gyur ba'i gnad bshad par bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i khog pa 'di yin pa'i phyir ro/// / yang na skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyis 'di skad du gsungs te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ sangs rgyas kyi gdung rgyun mi 'chad par bya ba'i slad du/ dus 'di nas gzung ste byang chub snying po la gnas kyi bar du/

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis kyi mchog la skyabs su mchi ste/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa/ thams cad gzigs pa/ 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba/ skyes bu chen po/ skyes bu khyu mchog sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ bla na med pa'i sku/ chos kyi sku mnga' ba la skyabs su mchi'o// chos 'dod chags dang bral ba'i mchog la skyabs su mchi ste/ bla na med pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mnga' ba/ zhi ba chos kyi sku/ so so rang gi rig pa la skyabs su mchi'o// dge 'dun dul ba tshogs kyi mchog la skyabs su mchi ste/ phyogs bzhi'i 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum bzlas/ ji snyed su dag ma'i mthar sems bskyed pa ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dag sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe sems can thams cad bsgral ba dang*/ sems can thams cad dgrol ba dang*/ sems can thams cad dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang*/ sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la 'god pa'i slad du/ ji ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang dus 'di nas gzung ste/ byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du sems can thams cad bsgral ba dang*/ sems can thams cad dgrol ba dang*/ sems can thams cad dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang*/ sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la 'god pa'i slad du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do// zhes gsungs shing lhag ma sngar bzhin du sbyar bar bya ba tshul gcig go

/gang yang rdo rje theg pa'i 'jug sgo cig /bdag nyid chen pos phye la gzhan khrid thabs// 'di'o ston 'dod rdo rje theg pa la// gus pa'i phyag 'tshal bdag gi las su bya// 'dir/ don dam pa'i sems byang chub sems dpa' sngags kyi sgo'i spyod pa spyad par 'dod pa rnams kyis bskyed par bya ba ni/ slob dpon gyis/ bu dus gsum du sgrib pa med par gnas pas dam tshig chen po la 'jug pa'i sdom pa nos shig ces bsgo/ slob mas phyag btsal thal mo sbyar pus mo btsugs te 'dug pas/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ slob dpon gyis dam tshig chen por 'jug pa'i sdom pa stsal du gsol/ ston pa'i bka' spyi bos nod par 'tshal lo// de nas slob dpon gyis/ rigs kyi bu dgongs shig bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa khyed kyis byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug gi bar du lhag pa'i bsam pas bdag gi lus sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la 'bul bar bgyi'o// de nas slob mas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas gzung ste/ nam byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bdag nyid dus thams cad du yong ye 'bul gyis/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du bzhes su gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas sdom pa gzung ngo*// don dam pa smon lam gyi rang bzhin can gyis bskyed pa yang*/ 'di skad ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas zhugs nas nam byang chub snying po la 'dug gi bar du/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched dang*/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa/

chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid kyis/ rang gi sems thog ma nas ma skyes pa/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin/ ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de ltar bdag gis byang chub tu sems bskyed do// zhes lan gsum gyis so// de ltar don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems cho gas bskyed pa rig gtad dam/ rjes su gnang ba'i dbang la ma bltos pa'i cho ga bya spyod kyi rgyud bdag nyid chen po rnams kyis lung du bkral ba ltar bshad pa 'di rnams kyang cog grwa bla ma dpal gyi seng ger grags pa'i dus 'khor ba de'i ngor/ byang chub sems dpa' padma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /
